The following data shows the temperature changes for a substance as it absorbs heat:

StageTemperature (°C)
Solid (starting)-10
Melting0
Liquid heating0 to 100
Boiling100
Gas heatingAbove 100

Which of the following statements is correct about the phase of the substance at ?

  1. It is entirely in the solid phase.
  2. It is entirely in the liquid phase.
  3. It is entirely in the gas phase.
  4. It could be a mixture of liquid and gas.
